function: Sensing DNN estimates vehicle angles from ISAC echoes; predicted angles then steer the RSU downlink beam (predictive beamforming), evaluated by angle error and sum-rate (pp. 4-7).
system: RSU with ULA of M=N=16, 32 or 64 transmit/receive antennas serving three vehicles over LoS channels; mmWave 30 GHz; no RIS (pp. 4, 9).
method: SACSMN, a CNN with dynamic self-attention, depthwise convolution and channel shuffle; supervised offline training by back-propagation on angle labels, few-shot with 1-100% of samples (pp. 7-10).
data_channel: Own simulated dataset from the paper's LoS echo model; Ntr=2000 runs of K=512 slots per array size for training, Nte=3000 runs for testing; no public dataset (p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained per array size on vehicles driving away from the RSU; tested on same-distribution data and on vehicles driving towards it from other start positions (pp. 9, 11).
baselines: Learned: AlexNet, CLDNN, MobileNet-V3, ResNet18, ShuffleNet-V2; non-learned: MUSIC, taken as upper bound; ablation SACSMN without self-attention (pp. 10-11).
metrics: Angle sensing error (RMSE), parameters, MACC, trade-off eta = MACC x error, achievable rate and sum-rate in bps (pp. 6, 11-13).
complexity: Parameters and MACC in Table V: SACSMN 0.45 M parameters, 0.6, 1.22 and 2.43 M MACC for M=N=16, 32, 64 (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 9: "there are no available open datasets. Therefore, we generated the corresponding dataset based on our proposed signal model." Not met: the channel is a custom LoS model with steering vectors (p. 4), with no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "Even though all the vehicles drive away from the RSU in the training set, high precision sensing is still achieved when all the vehicles drive towards the RSU in the test phase."
q3_support: p. 10: "We compare the proposed model with several widely used DNN models, including AlexNet [22], CLDNN [23], MobileNet-V3 [19], ResNet18 [24], and ShuffleNet-V2 [20]." p. 10: "multiple signal classification (MUSIC) [25] based scheme is viewed as upper bounds."
q4_support: p. 10: "both parameters and MACCs of the proposed model are minimal for the exact RSU configuration." Table V on p. 11 lists the numbers (SACSMN 0.45 M parameters, 0.6 M MACC at M=N=16).
q5_support: p. 9: "there are no available open datasets. Therefore, we generated the corresponding dataset based on our proposed signal model." Not met: the paper gives no code or data link and does not use a public dataset.
notes: Included as area 5: the DNN gives vehicle angles from echoes, the closed-form beamformer follows from the predicted angle (p. 7), and downlink sum-rate is reported (pp. 12-13). The exclusion for direction-of-arrival estimation alone was considered and not applied because the paper is framed as predictive beamforming and evaluates communication. q2 rests on a modest shift (direction of travel and start positions, Table VI, p. 11) of echo-based sensing; the reviewer should confirm it. q3 counts MUSIC (Fig. 7, p. 10) as the non-learned method, shown as an upper bound. Table values were read from the page images (pp. 9-13).
